def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    mask = bins >= item
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    eps = 1e-12
    p = 2.0
    priorities[mask] = -np.log((bins[mask] - item + eps) ** p)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    mask = bins >= item
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    if np.any(mask):
        remaining_capacity = bins[mask] - item
        extra_items = remaining_capacity // item
        difference = np.abs(remaining_capacity - 3 * item)
        priorities[mask] = extra_items + 1 / (1 + difference)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    import numpy as np
    mask = bins >= item
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    priorities[mask] = -np.square(bins[mask] - 4 * item)
    return priorities
